summary: A Telegram channel claims US forces fired hundreds of ATACMS and PrSM missiles from Kuwait into Iran's Khuzestan and Bushehr provinces. Iranian Parliament Speaker Ghalibaf warned of "appropriate measures" if US and Israel violate understandings, asserting the US cannot militarily confront Iran. Meanwhile, Israeli forces eliminated a senior Hamas commander in Gaza and a reservist was seriously wounded in southern Lebanon.
key_points: Iranian Parliament Speaker Ghalibaf threatened "appropriate measures" if US and Israel violate understandings, claiming US realized it cannot militarily confront Iran. (Source: @N12chat/215784)
A video circulated claiming US forces launched hundreds of ATACMS and PrSM missiles from HIMARS in Kuwait targeting Iran's Khuzestan and Bushehr provinces. (Source: @kianmeli1/88271)
IDF and Shin Bet killed Muhammad Naim Jandiya, head of military security for Hamas's Shuja'iyya battalion, involved in October 7 kidnapping and hostage holding. (Source: @yediotnews25/132234)
An IDF reservist was seriously wounded during an encounter in southern Lebanon and evacuated to hospital. (Source: @New_security8200/202203)

Houthi forces reportedly confronted Saudi warplanes attempting to block an Iranian civilian plane from landing at Sanaa airport, threatening retaliation against Saudi airports. (Source: @asafroz/50965)
French aircraft carrier Charles de Gaulle will return to France following the signing of a US-Iran memorandum of understanding. (Source: @naya_foriraq/80862)
High-level delegations from over 20 countries and Iranian-backed groups attended Khamenei's funeral, though China, Russia, and Turkey sent no senior officials. (Source: @VahidOnline/76777)
NYT reported the US warned Iran in real time of an alleged Israeli plot to assassinate Iranian negotiators Ghalibaf and Araghchi. (Source: @yediotnews25/132231)

sections.executive_summary: A Telegram channel claims US forces fired hundreds of ATACMS and PrSM missiles from Kuwait into Iran's Khuzestan and Bushehr provinces. Iranian Parliament Speaker Ghalibaf warned of "appropriate measures" if US and Israel violate understandings, asserting the US cannot militarily confront Iran. Meanwhile, Israeli forces eliminated a senior Hamas commander in Gaza and a reservist was seriously wounded in southern Lebanon.

points: Iran held massive funeral ceremonies for Supreme Leader Khamenei attended by delegations from over 20 countries including presidents of Iraq, Tajikistan, Georgia, prime ministers of Pakistan and Armenia, parliamentary speakers from Azerbaijan, Oman, Qatar, Iraq, Uzbekistan, Kyrgyzstan, Bangladesh, Egypt, and representatives from Taliban Afghanistan, Iraqi militias, Houthis, Lebanese Hezbollah, and Palestinian Islamic Jihad, while China, Russia, and Turkey notably absented senior officials. (Source: @VahidOnline/76777)

Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf declared Iran will resume "appropriate measures" if the US and Israel violate understandings, stating the US recognized during the war it lacks military capacity to confront Iran and dismissed Israeli claims as "baseless propaganda." (Source: @N12chat/215784, @pkpoi/143120, @yediotnews25/132235)

A video posted by a Telegram channel alleges US forces fired hundreds of ATACMS and/or PrSM precision missiles from M142 HIMARS launchers in Kuwait targeting Iran's Khuzestan and Bushehr provinces, though independent verification is lacking. (Source: @kianmeli1/88271)
IRGC Aerospace Force commander Majid Mousavi appeared at the Imam Khomeini musalla during funeral preparations, signaling senior military involvement in succession events. (Source: @kianmeli1/88266)

Deputy Parliament Speaker Ali Nikzad claimed the massive international attendance foiled a US plot to isolate Iran, while Ghalibaf retorted that a country with 40-plus million citizens on food stamps should not accuse another of hunger. (Source: @presstv/196772, @presstv/196768)
Mojtaba Khamenei, the late leader's son, was reportedly not expected to attend the funeral ceremonies, per uncensored security channels. (Source: @lelotsenzura/93334)

IDF and Shin Bet eliminated Muhammad Naim Jandiya, head of military security for Hamas's Shuja'iyya battalion, who led the Nukhba squad that kidnapped Capt. Daniel Peretz on October 7 and later held hostages Yotam Haim, Samer Al-Talalka, and Alon Shamriz in a Shuja'iyya tunnel. (Source: @yediotnews25/132234)
An IDF reservist was seriously wounded in an encounter in southern Lebanon on Thursday and evacuated to hospital, per the IDF spokesperson's statement. (Source: @New_security8200/202203)
Head of IDF Personnel Directorate Maj. Gen. Dado Bar Kalifa led a secret delegation visit to Morocco in recent days, indicating deepening military cooperation. (Source: @yediotnews25/132229)

The New York Times reported the US suspected in real time that Israel planned to assassinate Iranian negotiators Parliament Speaker Ghalibaf and Foreign Minister Araghchi, and warned Iran accordingly. (Source: @yediotnews25/132231)
A social media post claimed Mossad agents at Khamenei's funeral were instructed not to cry louder than Ghalibaf to avoid blowing cover, though unverified. (Source: @shin_persian/7365)
Israeli forces conducted an explosive demolition northeast of the Bani Suheila roundabout east of Khan Yunis in southern Gaza. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/374277)

IDF and Shin Bet killed Muhammad Naim Jandiya, head of military security for Hamas's Shuja'iyya battalion, who participated in the October 7 kidnapping of Capt. Daniel Peretz and held three Israeli hostages in a tunnel in Shuja'iyya. (Source: @yediotnews25/132234)
Israeli forces executed an explosive demolition operation northeast of the Bani Suheila roundabout east of Khan Yunis in southern Gaza. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/374277)
An IDF reservist was seriously wounded during an encounter in southern Lebanon on Thursday and evacuated to hospital for treatment, with family notified. (Source: @New_security8200/202203)
Israeli forces conducted a combing operation near the town of Beit Lif using machine gun fire around the Al-Zawater area. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/374283)
A loud explosion heard in the city of Tyre was identified as an electricity transformer blast behind the Jaafariya secondary school. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/374284)
First contact was made with wounded Muhammad Ali Hussein after he was found following 20 days missing in southern Lebanon. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/374282)

Iranian-backed militias from Iraq participated in Khamenei's funeral ceremonies in Tehran as part of the "semi-official militias supported by Iran in Iraq, Yemen, and Lebanon" delegation. (Source: @VahidOnline/76777)
The President of Iraq attended the funeral among other heads of state, indicating continued Iraqi-Iranian alignment. (Source: @VahidOnline/76777)

A video titled "Ya tharat al-Hussein... last meeting of the loyal brave soldier and his martyred commander" circulated on pro-Iran Iraqi channels, suggesting ongoing militia commemoration activities. (Source: @naya_foriraq/80859)
A Telegram channel posted video claiming US forces launched hundreds of ATACMS and PrSM missiles from HIMARS in Kuwait toward Iran's Khuzestan and Bushehr provinces. (Source: @kianmeli1/88271)
French President Macron announced the aircraft carrier Charles de Gaulle will return to France after the US and Iran signed a memorandum of understanding. (Source: @naya_foriraq/80862)

Houthi military spokesman claimed their forces confronted Saudi warplanes attempting to prevent an Iranian civilian plane from landing at Sanaa International Airport, threatening attacks on Saudi airports and vital land and sea interests if violations continue. (Source: @asafroz/50965)
A mass rally in Sanaa's Seventy Square supported Houthi leadership and armed forces for "breaking the siege equation" and thanked Iran for its supportive stance. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/374276)

Delegations from Pakistan, Azerbaijan, India, Oman, and other Gulf and Asian states attended Khamenei's funeral, per flight tracking and Iranian media. (Source: @shin_persian/7355, @shin_persian/7352)
China, Russia, and Turkey notably did not send high-ranking officials to the funeral despite being key Iranian partners. (Source: @VahidOnline/76777)
